standard_prerequisites.name: Every object of the derived category of systems admits a K-flat representative system
A K-flat representative can be used to compute derived tensor products, and the result is independent of the representative on the other side, by the K-flat quasi-isomorphism and derived-tor lemmas
Exactness of the termwise derived tensor in each variable

core_obligations: Definition: choose a K-flat representative system (K_n) for K by the get-K-flat-system lemma and define the derived tensor as the system of total complexes Tot(K_n tensor_{A_n} L_n) for any representative (L_n) of L (proof lines 23869-23876).

Well-definedness: independent of the choice of (L_n) and of the K-flat replacement by the K-flat quasi-isomorphism lemma and the derived-tor other-side lemma; compatibility with the projections to D(A_n) is immediate from the construction (proof lines 23877-23880).
Symmetry is visible from the definition and exactness in each variable follows exactly as in the derived-tor exactness lemma (proof lines 23880-23882).
proof_roadmap: Construct the derived tensor via a K-flat system (proof lines 23869-23876).
